title: Staff JWT placed in EventSource and upload query strings
description: A lower-trust observer of API/proxy access logs or the HTTP request target can recover a staff JWT. The dashboard EventSource URL includes access_token= the live token. The same Query parameter authenticates SSE and catalog upload routes. Tokens last up to 30 days by default and are not revoked on password change.
claimed_root_cause: get_current_user_sse accepts Query access_token as equivalent to Authorization Bearer, and the dashboard EventSource puts that JWT in the URL. Default uvicorn process logging records the request query.

trace.description: Browser builds /jobs/{id}/events?access_token= plus the staff JWT and opens EventSource on it.
FastAPI Query access_token is documented as the EventSource JWT and is optional beside HTTP Bearer.
Query value is OR'd with Bearer credentials and passed to user_from_access_token, minting a full User principal for SSE and for POST /jobs/upload and /jobs/{id}/upload-files.

evidence.description: EventSource URL concatenates encodeURIComponent(token) into query access_token.
token = Bearer credentials or stripped access_token query; empty raises 401.
job_events_sse Depends(get_current_user_sse) and documents query access_token.
create_job_from_upload Depends(get_current_user_sse), so query JWT also authorizes multipart catalog upload.
Production API is uvicorn app.main:app without --no-access-log.
Container CMD also launches uvicorn without disabling access logs.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox and parent artifact promotion unavailable

validation_plan.local: In the required OS sandbox with dummy tenants, mint a JWT via TestClient, GET /jobs/{id}/events?access_token=dummy and POST /jobs/upload?access_token=dummy, confirm the query door authenticates, and capture the uvicorn access-log request target containing the access_token query name (redact token values).
validation_plan.deployment: Owner inspects existing Railway/API access-log settings and any retained /jobs/*/events?access_token= lines; do not replay live tokens or probe production.
